## Research Summary

This project examines how patent-based technological assets and trademark-based brand assets co-appear within leading R&D firms. The work treats corporate innovation as a portfolio of different knowledge assets rather than a single count of outputs. At the current stage, the project focuses on indicator construction, portfolio comparison, and descriptive typology based on linked intellectual-property records.

## Abstract

<p class="abstract-text">The project develops a measurement framework for comparing technological and brand-oriented innovation portfolios. It links patent and trademark records to firm-year observations and uses that structure to describe how different types of innovation assets are combined. The current stage does not report mature empirical findings; it establishes the data architecture and measurement logic needed for later analysis of firm heterogeneity, industry context, and national innovation environments.</p>

## Keywords

Innovation portfolios · Patents · Trademarks · Corporate R&D · Knowledge assets
